system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:50 UTC, ivy.chen's WINWORD.EXE opened C:\Users\ivy.chen\Downloads\Statement.docm from Explorer.

Two seconds later, Word launched PowerShell with -nop, -w hidden, and -enc. The encoded command decodes to an expression that downloads a script using WebClient.DownloadString from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1.
The proxy recorded a successful GET (status 200) for that script URL, associated with the same tunnel as a raw.githubusercontent.com connection from WS-ICHEN-01.

PowerShell then launched rundll32.exe to invoke C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll,Init. The records establish the process launch, but not whether the DLL loaded or its Init routine succeeded.
PowerShell, Word, and rundll32.exe subsequently terminated within roughly 16 seconds of the PowerShell launch.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show the request URL and status but do not provide the downloaded script's response body or contents (T043-00132).
The supplied process records do not include the DLL or script contents, file hashes, or evidence confirming successful DLL loading or execution (T043-00128, T043-00139, T043-00143).
The evidence covers the supplied records for the review interval; it does not establish activity outside that interval.
claims_not_established: Whether the GitHub repository or downloaded script was authorized by the organization.
The exact behavior or impact of the downloaded script or DLL, including whether either performed additional actions.
Whether the DLL was successfully loaded and executed.
Whether there was persistence, credential access, lateral movement, or data exfiltration.
Whether ivy.chen knowingly opened the document or enabled any macro.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and preserve Statement.docm, u.ps1, and svchelper.dll; record hashes and analyze their contents and provenance.
Collect endpoint file-creation, module-load, PowerShell script-block, AMSI, and Defender telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around the execution time.
Obtain proxy response-body or cache evidence and determine whether the nwd-it/tools repository and requested script are organization-approved.
Review subsequent endpoint and network activity for persistence, credential access, lateral movement, or data transfer.
